observations.detail: AUTH: CLI_ACCOUNT_INELIGIBLE: the signed-in Google account's Gemini Code Assist tier no longer serves Gemini CLI. Sign in with an account whose plan includes Gemini CLI use (for a Workspace or Standard license also export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT), or bind this role to another endpoint: Error authenticating: IneligibleTierError: This client is no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals
